name: export-cleaner-desktop
description: Export Cleaner for Mac: the web app in its own window, working offline.

scripts.build:web: cd .. && npx vite build --mode desktop --outDir desktop/web --emptyOutDir
scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run offline && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:web && npm run offline && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
